summary: Bearer's wielded weapons are Hardened, and their melee weapons (and Special Effects they deliver) ignore Magic Armor and wound-preventing Resistances.

effects.subject: bearer-equipment
effects.note: Bearer's wielded weapons are affected as per Harden.

effects.subject: bearer
effects.note: Bearer's wielded melee weapons and any Special Effects delivered by them ignore Magic Armor.

effects.subject: bearer
effects.note: Bearer's wielded melee weapons and any Special Effects delivered by them ignore Resistances that prevent wounds.

properties.note: Wielded melee weapons and any Special Effects they deliver ignore Magic Armor.
Only Resistances that prevent wounds; applies to wielded melee weapons and the Special Effects they deliver.

clarifications.text: The bypass covers any Special Effects delivered by the bearer's wielded melee weapons, not only the wounds they cause.

open_questions: E1 applies Harden to all 'wielded weapons' while E2 limits the bypass to melee weapons; the text does not say whether thrown weapons are Hardened too (plainer reading: yes).
